## Standing operator rules
- Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.
- Never modify files under `ledgerly/customer_export/` without posting the proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and receiving approval from `@mina`.
- Carry on with the current work while away.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Do not retry increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to 6 hours; it was ruled out.
- Staging Redis moved to `cache-eu-3`; `cache-eu-1` is being drained and must not receive writes.
- Kafka repartition offset migration is separate and must run in between other work.

## Current objective
Fix incorrect Canadian Quebec QST tax calculation in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`. Invoice tracing is superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Kafka: `kafka-01:9092`; `orders.v1` (6), `orders.v2` (12); groups `orders-v1`, `orders-v2`.
- Redis: `redis://cache-eu-3:6379`; `cache-eu-1` is superseded.
- Reassignment: `/var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json`; offsets: `/var/tmp/orders-v1-offsets.txt`.

## Plan and progress
- Kafka steps 2–9 pending; step 3 output status unknown.
- Next: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v1 --describe --offsets > /var/tmp/orders-v1-offsets.txt`
- Quebec tax fix pending; next: `pytest -q tests/tax`

## Recent work
Search rebuild, CSV UTF-8 fix, and tests completed; full service passed 247 tests.
